message: The other day, as the winds started howling and the rain pelted against the windows, I found myself rummaging through the closet for flashlights. Instead, I stumbled upon a dusty old board game from my kids' childhood. We ended up huddled around the table, laughing and reminiscing, while the storm raged outside. Sometimes, a little low-tech fun is just the escape we need when the weather doesn’t cooperate. What’s your favorite indoor activity when the skies turn gray? ☁️
